name: kerbapex
description: DriverDirector (automated replay videos), StintRadio (a race engineer on the radio) and RemoteDisplay (virtual monitor for remote use) for sim racing (RaceRoom Racing Experience and Le Mans Ultimate).

plugins.name: driverdirector
plugins.description: Set up, configure and run DriverDirector, the automated replay director for RaceRoom Racing Experience and Le Mans Ultimate.

plugins.name: stintradio
plugins.description: A race engineer on the radio while you drive RaceRoom Racing Experience or Le Mans Ultimate.

plugins.name: remotedisplay
plugins.description: Virtual display so a remote PC keeps a proper resolution (e.g. 3440x1440) when the monitor is off.

plugins.name: kerbapex-dev
plugins.description: Debugger and sandboxed self-improvement rounds for DriverDirector and StintRadio (works on its own git branch; you approve).
